fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) declined 46% from its June high of $1,213.56 to $656 on November 5, but currently at $712 represents approximately 150% gain from the year-start of $285.
fields.summary_ko.1: MU has experienced the sixth instance of declines exceeding 40% from peak in its history (1985, 1995, 2000, 2022, 2024), with past cases showing further declines before recovery.
fields.summary_ko.2: During the 2000s decline, the stock fell an additional 68% one year later and took 21+ years to recover, while in 2022 and 2024 cases, recovery occurred within one year, with memory chip price trends determining the pace of stock recovery.
